newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather-Number 3 strong winds signal hoisted.
newsitem.headline: HK weather-Number 3 strong winds signal hoisted.

text.p: Hong Kong's Number Three strong wind warning signal was hoisted on Monday morning indicating the territory would experience showers, squally at times, and winds of up to 62 kmh, the Royal Observatory said on Monday.
At 8 a.m. the centre of typhoon Sally was estimated to be about 270 km southwest of Hong Kong and was forecast to move west-northwest at about 35 km towards the coast of southern China.
The Number Eight typhoon signal was hoisted for around three hours overnight when gale force winds battered Hong Kong.
It was replaced with the Number Three signal at about 5.45 am (2100 GMT).
